data.title: Income tax assessment 2025 (Einkommensteuerbescheid)
data.summary: The Finanzamt Musterhemelingen assessed Bente Beispielhusen's income tax for 2025 and found a refund (Guthaben) of €570.00, which will be transferred to their bank account. The assessment also notes that an objection (Einspruch) can be filed within one month of notification if the figures are disputed.
data.explanation: This is your official income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for the year 2025 from the Finanzamt. Based on your declared income and deductions, you have a credit (Guthaben) of €570.00, which the tax office will transfer to the account on file — no action is needed from you to receive it. If you think any figures (income, deductible expenses, or the note about your disability insurance contributions) are wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with this tax office; the app shows the exact deadline for that. If you do nothing within that period, the assessment becomes final. Keep this notice for your records, as it documents your 2025 income and taxes for future reference.
